I can't say for how the editing process was done.

But Infamous Insurgent (along with Lilith's Blessing) were apparently playtested at the same time as the Heirs to the Blood set. So LSJ at least had the opportunity to correct it during this period (it's quite possible that it slipped by though, considering the sheer amount of work he was doing).

It also wasn't Ben Swainbank (the previous storyline coordinator) making last minute changes. Although he submitted the original idea, he had no idea how the card would turn out in its final version.

It could be that CCP (or LSJ) had a separate editing process for storyline or promo cards, which, if true, could have contributed to the mistake.
